Definition: Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings
BiblicalUsage: Ben-Hadad means "son of [the false god] Hadad." The name is shared by several bearers: The king of Syria, contemporary with Asa of Judah; The son of Hazael, also king of Syria. It turns up across the Bible, including 1 Kings 15:18 and 1 Kings 15:20.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ben-Hadad is worth remembering, even when little else is told — God counts His people one by one.
RelatedPeople: Ben-Hadad I, King of Syria; Ben-Hadad II, King of Syria
